main_text.p:
13. Huic pyropi flamulis.
Cæterisque gemmulis,
Orbe clausis aureo,
Candidæ fulgent manus.
Corpus huic eburneum,
Cærulis intermicans,
Hinc & inde gemmulis.

14. Corp°hoc quæ sustinet
Crura, crura vix putes,
Sed columnas marmoris
Dixeris lectissimi,
Singulæ quas singulas
Aureæ feruant bases,
Denique hunc incedere
Sic sublimem qui videt,
Credat aut se Libanum,
Aut cedrum se Libani,
Ambulantem cernere.

15. Regnat huius intimo
In palato Suauiras.
Quintus iste denique,
Quantus, inquam, totus est
Illecebra totus est,
Totus est pellacia.
Talis ille noster est
Vnicè charus mihi,
O Sionis filiæ.
main_text.head: ODE VI.
TICI

page.notes: Lower-left corner shows a partial mark (a small hand-drawn or stray mark), not transcribed. "Haud" at the foot may be a catchword. Several words are uncertain in the verse (e.g. "lectissimis", "ductitans") due to the scan; no [?] marks were added beyond these.
